scope: Fresh public source archive and release download via HTTPS without Authorization headers, cookies, API keys or developer input caches. Local Python uses preinstalled packages; no dependency installation or new live provider call.

video.title: TraceX | AI Evidence Checks with Muse Spark | Meta AI Hackathon
video.method: yt-dlp metadata only with --ignore-config and --no-cache-dir; no credentials or cookies supplied

review_evidence.validation: published review/import hashes, taxonomy, source votes and adjudication consistency
review_evidence.review_blinding: Unconfirmed: blinding confirmation was requested and no answer recorded. Independence supported by imperfect agreement, original notes, and cross-reviewer convergence only.
review_evidence.limits: Attestation and internal consistency do not independently authenticate a reviewer, establish blinding or prove mechanical truth. Withdrawn/assisted archival rounds are not counted as new independent review.

public_model_replay.validation: saved local-student predictions and alert evaluation match the original saved result
public_model_replay.limits: Replays cached embeddings/fitted weights and saved text-filter decisions. It does not regenerate embeddings, raw ingestion, provider outputs, training selection or human grades.
